Now we compute and . We have and , so we find that We first compute: \begin{align*} \overline yz-y\overline z &= \left(-\frac{a+b+c}{b^2-ac}\right)\left(\frac{c(ab+bc+ca)}{c^2-ab}\right) - \left(\frac{b(ab+bc+ca)}{b^2-ac}\right)\left(-\frac{a+b+c}{c^2-ab}\right)\\ &= -\frac{(a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)}{(b^2-ac)(c^2-ab)}\cdot (c-b)\\ y-z &= \frac{b}{b^2-ac}(ab+bc+ca)-\frac{c}{c^2-ab}(ab+bc+ca)\\ &= \frac{(ab+bc+ca)^2}{(b^2-ac)(c^2-ab)}\cdot (c-b)\\ \overline y-\overline z &= \frac{a+b+c}{c^2-ab}-\frac{a+b+c}{b^2-ac}\\ &= -\frac{(a+b+c)^2}{(b^2-ac)(c^2-ab)}\cdot (c-b). \end{align*} Then \begin{align*} d &= \frac{(ab+bc+ca)^2(b+c)-(a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)bc}{(ab+bc+ca)^2 - (a+b+c)^2}\\ &= (ab+bc+ca)\cdot \frac{ab^2+b^2c+abc+abc+bc^2+c^2a-abc-b^2c-bc^2}{a^2b^2+b^2c^2+c^2a^2+2a^2bc+2ab^2c+2abc^2 - a^2bc-b^3c-bc^3-2ab^2c-2abc^2-2b^2c^2}\\ &= \frac{a(ab+bc+ca)(b^2+bc+c^2)}{a^2b^2+a^2c^2-b^2c^2+a^2bc-b^3c-bc^3} = \frac{a(ab+bc+ca)}{a^2-bc},\\ \overline d &= -\frac{a+b+c}{a^2-bc}, \end{align*} and \begin{align*} e &= \frac{(ab+bc+ca)^2(p+a) - (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)pa}{(ab+bc+ca)^2 - (a+b+c)^2pa}\\ &= (ab+bc+ca)\cdot \frac{(ab+bc+ca)(p+a)-(ab+bc+ca)a}{(ab+bc+ca)^2 - (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)a}\\ &= \frac{(ab+bc+ca)^2/(a+b+c)}{(ab+bc+ca)-(a+b+c)a}\\ &= -\frac{(ab+bc+ca)^2}{(a+b+c)(a^2-bc)},\\ \overline e &= \frac{a(a+b+c)^2}{(a^2-bc)(ab+bc+ca)}. \end{align*} At this point let and . This is equivalent to the statement that But indeed, \begin{align*} p(\overline e-\overline d)+\overline p (e-d) &= \frac{Y}{X}\left(\frac{aX^2}{(a^2-bc)Y}+\frac{X}{a^2-bc}\right) + \frac{X}{Y}\left(-\frac{Y^2}{(a^2-bc)X}-\frac{aY}{a^2-bc}\right) = 0\\ e\overline e - d\overline d &= -\frac{Y^2}{(a^2-bc)X}\cdot \frac{aX^2}{(a^2-bc)Y} + \frac{aY}{a^2-bc}\cdot \frac{X}{a^2-bc} = 0, \end{align*} so both sides are equal.
